name: PostHog
summary: PostHog by voice: flags, insights, dashboards, funnels, retention, persons, cohorts, recordings, queries, and events.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key
preferences.description: Your Composio API key from app.composio.dev/settings.

preferences.name: POSTHOG_API_KEY
preferences.title: PostHog Personal API Key
preferences.description: Personal API key from PostHog (Account Settings -> Personal API Keys).

preferences.name: POSTHOG_REGION
preferences.title: PostHog Region
preferences.description: Your PostHog cloud region: US or EU.

preferences.name: POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID
preferences.title: PostHog Project ID
preferences.description: Optional project ID. If left blank, the integration will auto-detect your project.

tools.name: list_feature_flags
tools.title: List feature flags
tools.description: List the feature flags in your PostHog project with their on/off status and rollout. Use when the user asks which flags exist or for an overview of flags. For one specific flag's full details use get_feature_flag.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

limit.description: Number of flags to list (1-10, default 5).

tools.name: get_insights
tools.title: Get insights
tools.description: List the project's saved insights, or get the latest results of one saved insight by ID or short ID. Use when the user asks about saved insights or charts they already have in PostHog. For an ad-hoc funnel between events use get_funnel, for retention use get_retention, and for a custom question use run_query.

insight_id.description: Optional insight ID or short_id to get detailed metrics.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.title: Get dashboard
tools.description: List project dashboards with pinned status and card counts, or view details for a specific dashboard. Use when the user asks for PostHog dashboards.

dashboard_id.description: Optional dashboard ID to retrieve specific dashboard cards.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: get_event_definitions
tools.title: Get event definitions
tools.description: List tracked event definitions and schema with 30-day ingestion volume. Use when the user asks about tracked events, event schemas, or event volume in PostHog.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

limit.description: Number of event definitions to list (1-15, default 6).

tools.name: get_feature_flag
tools.title: Get feature flag
tools.description: Get full details of one PostHog feature flag by its ID or key: status, rollout conditions, variants, and who created it. Use when the user asks about a specific flag.

key.description: Feature flag key, e.g. 'new-checkout'. Used when no ID is given.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: get_funnel
tools.title: Get funnel insights
tools.description: Run a conversion funnel over 2 or more events in order and return how many users reached each step. Use when the user asks about conversion, drop-off, or a funnel between events.

steps.description: Event names in funnel order, at least 2 (e.g. ['$pageview', 'signed_up']).

date_from.description: Start of the date range, e.g. '-30d', '-7d', or '2026-01-01'. Default '-30d'.

window_days.description: Days a user has to complete the funnel (1-90, default 14).

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: get_retention
tools.title: Get retention insights
tools.description: Calculate user retention: of the users who did a start event in each period, how many came back and did a return event later. Use when the user asks about retention, churn, or whether users come back.

target_event.description: Event that puts a user into a cohort. Default '$pageview'.

returning_event.description: Event that counts as coming back. Defaults to the target event.

intervals.description: Number of periods to analyze (2-12, default 7).

retention_type.description: 'first_time' (default) cohorts users by their first event; 'recurring' by any occurrence.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: run_query
tools.title: Run report query
tools.description: Run a read-only HogQL (PostHog SQL) SELECT query and return up to 50 rows. Tables include events (event, timestamp, distinct_id, properties.$current_url, ...), persons, and sessions. Use when the user asks a custom data question no other PostHog tool answers.

sql.description: A single HogQL SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) query, e.g. "SELECT event, count() FROM events GROUP BY event ORDER BY count() DESC".

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: get_persons
tools.title: Get persons
tools.description: Look up people tracked in PostHog: list or search persons by email or distinct ID, or get one person's details and properties by their UUID. Read-only. Use when the user asks who a user is or wants to find users.

person_id.description: Person UUID for one person's details.

search.description: Search by email (full text) or distinct ID (exact).

limit.description: Number of persons to list (1-10, default 5).

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: get_cohorts
tools.title: Get cohorts
tools.description: List PostHog cohorts (saved groups of users) with their sizes, or get one cohort's details and filters by ID. Use when the user asks about cohorts, segments, or user groups.

cohort_id.description: Numeric cohort ID for one cohort's details.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: get_actions
tools.title: Get actions
tools.description: List PostHog actions (named definitions that group events, like 'Signed up'), or get one action's matching steps by ID. Use when the user asks about actions or how an action is defined.

action_id.description: Numeric action ID for one action's details.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: get_session_recordings
tools.title: Get session recordings
tools.description: List recent PostHog session recordings with duration, user, and activity, or get one recording's details by ID. Use when the user asks about session replays or recordings.

recording_id.description: Session recording ID for one recording's details.

limit.description: Number of recordings to list (1-10, default 5).

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

tools.name: create_feature_flag
tools.title: Create feature flag
tools.description: Create a new boolean feature flag in PostHog. New flags are created OFF with 0% rollout unless the user explicitly asks for it to be on or names a percentage. Use when the user asks to add, create, or set up a feature flag.

key.description: Flag key used in code: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores (e.g. 'new-checkout').

active.description: Whether the flag is on immediately. Use false unless the user explicitly asks for it to be on.

rollout_percentage.description: Percent of users who get the flag, 0-100. Use "0" unless the user explicitly names a percentage.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

children.text: Creates this flag in your PostHog project. Check the state and rollout before approving.

tools.name: capture_event
tools.title: Capture event
tools.description: Send one custom analytics event to PostHog, optionally with properties. Use when the user asks to log, track, send, or record an event in PostHog.

distinct_id.description: ID of the user the event belongs to. Use 'voiceos' if the user doesn't name one.

properties.description: Optional event properties as a JSON object string, e.g. '{"plan": "pro"}'.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project ID. Uses default project if omitted.

children.text: Sends this event to your PostHog project. Events can't be unsent.
